title: Narrow semantic cleanup using the T9 ledger
scope: T10 only; T11-T16 remain PLANNED and were not started

changed_files.change: nsec() calls direct _NSEC(53) instead of obj_process_self_time()
changed_files.reason: same 64-bit todget(nil,nil) source with one syscall instead of OBJOPEN/OBJINVOKE/OBJCLOSE
no remaining source caller after libc nsec() and plan9.time_ns() moved to direct _NSEC(53)

changed_files.change: removed obj_process_self_time declaration; documented direct libc path and retained ObjOpTimeNow provider
changed_files.reason: adapter has no caller; raw OBJINVOKE remains an exposed compatibility surface
remove the last source dependency on the retired time adapter

abi.obj_time_now: ObjOpTimeNow=27 retained as a provider; no in-tree caller after T10; historical value unchanged

time.preserved: 64-bit nanosecond source, epoch, precision and vlong nsec(void) signature
time.changed_failure_behavior: old adapter returned 0 if ProcessSelf open/invoke failed (for example Handle exhaustion); direct _NSEC has no error path and always returns todget()

wait.reason: _WAIT(36) returned only a PID and AWAIT(47) a formatted string, so either would revive an obsolete convention; a new number is out of scope; obj_wait -> ObjOpWait -> vobjwait -> pwait already uses the sole kernel core and preserves typed ObjWait, Vcontrol ProcessSelf authorization and no-child/concurrent-wait errors

other_candidates.reason: direct handler remains; libc errstr uses ObjOpErrstrExchange; missing trace callers is not proof of safe removal
bootstrap/legacy Space fallback dependency; obootoid still has an OSPACEGET failure-path caller
no in-tree caller or runtime observation, but absence of evidence is not permission for speculative removal
providers exist; no measured consumer, but removal is not justified by T10 evidence
explicit compatibility/unsupported surface; active interfaces not changed speculatively

micropython.nsec_static: nsec jumps to _nsec; _nsec sets RBP=0x35 (53); obj_process_self_time symbol absent
